mods.name: Boss Timers On Screen
mods.author: Doogle
mods.description:
Shows the Kongor and Phoenix respawn timers on the right side of the screen at all times so you do not need to hold the scoreboard key to see them.

The mod quietly requests scoreboard data in the background, so the timers stay current on their own without ever opening the scoreboard. The rows show dashes only for the first few seconds of a match before the first data arrives.

mods.name: Brighter Ward Spots
mods.author: Doogle
mods.description: Recolors the ward spot markers painted on the map into a bright gold glow so they are much easier to see.

mods.name: Clean Summon Alt Info
mods.author: Doogle
mods.description: Hides the owner hero icon, the unit name and the dark background from the info panel that appears above summoned units when you hold Alt, like Slither toxin wards and Pharaoh mummies, so they are much less visually cluttered. Affects every summoned pet unit.

mods.name: Click Through Top Bar
mods.author: Doogle
mods.description: Lets right clicks pass through the whole top bar, the hero portraits, the kda numbers, the clock and the creep score, so it stops blocking right click movement near the top of the screen. Left clicks and alt click pings still work like normal.

mods.name: WardUp Lobby Stats
mods.author: Doogle
mods.description:
**Needs the mod manager running while you play.**

Hover over a player name during the picking phase to see a small WardUp stats card above the game with their MMR, win rate, KDA and top heroes. Everyone in the lobby is looked up once when the draft starts, so the cards appear instantly. A WardUp entry is also added to the right click menu on players in chat and to the player menu in the game lobby, which opens their full WardUp page in a floating window. Click the WardUp entry again on the same player to close it.

Stats come straight from ward-up.com.
